title: Standard Drop
tagline: A marketing tool for dropping limited Membership NFTs on Warpcast
description: Just as Supreme hosts drop event where limited goods are released in limited time period, Standard makes a frame that releases limited membership with collaboration between NFT artists to provide perks and events. This will add valuation to an artist's NFT by enchanting utility from a working dapp. Also it will give an identity and unique taste to its users of Standard app.
how_its_made: It uses frames.js to make tx button to mint membership NFT with subscription. It mints NFT and registers to Standard's membership program with exclusive benefits and perks such as fee discount and VIP level promotion. Collaborations between artists will last for every month, hosting new artists with new events like donating 1% of minting fee to 1% of The world.
